description: This file defines a class for integrating Pinecone vector store with LlamaIndex, including methods for upserting documents, initializing index, querying, and managing the Pinecone vector store. It also exports the class for use in other parts of the project.

classes.name: PineconeLlamaIndex_VectorStores
classes.description: Implements a vector store node for Pinecone integration with LlamaIndex, supporting document upsert, index initialization, and retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: PineconeVectorStore
classes.description: A class extending VectorStoreBase to interface with Pinecone database, supporting add, delete, query, and index management operations.

methods.name: vectorStoreMethods.upsert
methods.description: Upserts documents into the Pinecone vector store, converting documents to the required format and storing them.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Pinecone index or retriever based on provided node data and options.

methods.name: getDb
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the Pinecone database client.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Retrieves the specific Pinecone index object.

methods.name: clearIndex
methods.description: Deletes all entries in the current Pinecone index.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds embedding results to the Pinecone index.

methods.name: saveChunk
methods.description: Saves a chunk of data to the Pinecone index.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a document by reference ID from the Pinecone index.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a similarity search query on the Pinecone index.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Placeholder for persisting the vector store, currently does nothing.

methods.name: textFromResultRow
methods.description: Extracts text content from a query result row.

methods.name: nodeToRecord
methods.description: Converts a node to a record suitable for Pinecone upsert.
